category: LaunchPad competes as the start page of a digital workplace: the page an employee lands on after signing in, which gathers the tools, links, news and live figures that person needs, arranged per role by an administrator and personalised within limits by the employee. Inside Nextcloud it replaces the built-in Dashboard. Outside Nextcloud the buyer compares it with employee-workspace portals (Workspace 365, Microsoft Viva Connections) and, at the self-hosted end, with homelab start pages (Homarr, Dashy). It is not a business-intelligence tool: charts appear only as widgets over data another app holds, so Grafana, Metabase, Superset and Power BI are out of the category. Written 2026-09-25 from appinfo/info.xml, openspec/specs (79 capabilities), src/manifest.json and lib/Settings/. Correct this paragraph first if it is wrong; the areas, rows and columns follow from it.
